intro: We hold a recorded total fee for {{count}} published MCA / MCM colleges in India. This page gathers the top MCA / MCM colleges in India with fees 2026, so you can see what a two-year programme costs before you shortlist it.
The colleges at the top follow our verified 2026 ranking where we hold a fee. After them, colleges are ordered by recorded total fee, lowest first.
listLead: The first cards include Harcourt Butler Technological University in Kanpur, then several Tamil Nadu colleges with recorded fees just above ₹11,000. Read the programme name, and check whether that figure is one year or the full course.
snapshot: Across the {{feeN}} published colleges on this list, the median recorded total fee is {{feeMedian}}. The middle half of colleges sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
A low figure is worth a second look, especially when several private colleges show the same amount. Most colleges here are private ({{private}}), with {{public}} public institutes.
Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Telangana, Karnataka, Uttar Pradesh and Punjab have the most listings. State tests such as TANCET, ICET and MAH MCA CET appear often in our records.
firstCollegesLead: Harcourt Butler Technological University is listed first, with a recorded MCA fee of ₹36,730–₹1.73 lakh and a 2023 average package of ₹3 lakh. That placement figure is a historical record for 2023, not a promise.

NIT Trichy, NIT Warangal, NIT Surathkal, NIT Calicut, JNU and Manipal are missing from this fee list because we do not yet hold a total fee for them. Several early Tamil Nadu cards show ₹11,666 or ₹13,666, which should be checked on the official notice.

sections.heading: How MCA admissions usually work in 2026
paragraphs: There is no single national MCA test for every college on this list. In our records, many colleges are linked to state tests such as TANCET, ICET or MAH MCA CET, and some to NIMCET or CUET PG.
Use this list of top MCA / MCM colleges in India 2026 as a shortlist, then read the eligibility and test required on that college’s admission page.

compare.heading: How to compare the top MCA / MCM colleges in India with fees 2026
paragraphs: Start with the fee notice, not only the card, because a two-year MCA fee and a one-year tuition figure are not the same thing.
Then check these points on the official site:
bullets: Whether the published fee is for the full two years or for one year, and whether university or exam fees are included.
The entrance test used in the latest cycle (TANCET, NIMCET, a state CET, or CUET PG) and the cut-off for your category.
Whether the college awards an MCA degree of a university, and whether the programme is approved for the current year.
The latest official placement report for the MCA batch, treated as a historical record rather than a promise.

faqs.question: How many MCA colleges in India have fees listed here?
faqs.answer: {{count}} published MCA / MCM colleges have a recorded total fee in our records, and colleges without a fee on file are not placed on this list.

faqs.question: What is the typical MCA fee in India in 2026?
faqs.answer: Among the {{feeN}} published colleges here, the median recorded total fee is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half falls between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.

faqs.question: Why are NIT Trichy and JNU missing from this fee list?
faqs.answer: They are well-known MCA campuses, but we do not hold a total fee for them yet, so they cannot be placed in a fee list. You can still look for national MCA colleges on the main listing page.

faqs.question: Is the lowest MCA fee on this list the cheapest two-year course?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily, because several early cards show figures just above ₹11,000 that may be one-year tuition, so confirm the full programme cost on the official fee notice.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do these MCA colleges use?
faqs.answer: Our records most often link colleges here to state tests such as ICET, TANCET and MAH MCA CET, and some to NIMCET or CUET PG. Confirm the test the college used in the latest cycle.
